edit_task.name: edit_task
edit_task.description: Edit a task's properties: project_id, title, description, priority, task_type, status, max_retries, verification_type, integration_mode, skip_verification, intelligence_class, affinity_agent_id, affinity_reason, workspace_mode, needs_attention, or clear_needs_attention. Use this to move a task to a different project, rename tasks, change priority, override status (admin), change the routing hints, adjust retry/verification settings, or set coordination parameters. A task's route (profile, provider, model, pin) is the router's and is refused here (routing.choice_forbidden).

project_id.description: Move task to a different project (optional)

task_type.description: New task type (optional, set to null to clear)

status.description: New status — admin override, bypasses state machine (optional)

intelligence_class.description: Intelligence-class hint for the router; change only while unassigned. Null clears it. On a queued task, editing the class hint or task_type sends the task back to its router.

integration_mode.description: Integration-policy override ('direct' | 'pull_request'). Null clears the override so the task inherits the project/system policy (optional)

skip_verification.description: If true, skip git verification on task completion (optional)

affinity_agent_id.description: Preferred agent ID for context continuity. Set to null to clear (optional)

affinity_reason.description: Why this agent is preferred. Set to null to clear (optional)

workspace_mode.description: Workspace lock mode. Set to null to clear (optional). 'branch-isolated' is DEPRECATED and behaves as 'exclusive' — see create_task.

after_review.description: Attach this task to the named document review's gate until the review is approved.

wait_register.name: wait_register
wait_register.description: Register a bounded typed wait and end the turn until its result pointer arrives.

wait_get.name: wait_get
wait_get.description: Read a durable wait, optionally consuming its result notification.

wait_list.name: wait_list
wait_list.description: List the owner's durable wait history.

wait_cancel.name: wait_cancel
wait_cancel.description: Cancel a current-claim wait and queue its result.

review_notes: The hibernation epic (verified wait cutover a278d71d3 and its prerequisites) changes the wait and job command surfaces: wait_register/get/list/cancel and message_wait accept schema_version=2 conditions and return verified wait records; job_submit/get/cancel results carry the registered wait and decision.
edit_task's status enum gains the suspended lifecycle states (ASSIGNED, WAITING, HIBERNATED, RESUME_PENDING, WAITING_INPUT, PAUSED); suspended transitions require wait controls.

New explicit commands wait_ack/checkpoint/decide/explain/graph/lift and internal fallback service boundaries are additive. Reverting exactly this delta recovers the withheld-source catalogue bytes; historical recordings remain unchanged.
